desc: Modernize your AK with the UTG PRO AK Side Folding Stock, offered for standard AK and Zastava AK/Yugo M70 rifles. It provides a 5-position quick-deploy length of pull, a rubberized butt pad, QD sling mounts at the front and rear, and right-side folding for compact storage and transport. The stock counts as one US compliance part under 922R. Proudly made in the USA.
